description: This agent is used to send text to user if the user agrees to it.

beforeAgentCallbacks.description: Update the `offer_text_instruction` variable once upon entering the Computer Troubleshooting Agent.

beforeModelCallbacks.description: Play SMS "message and data rates may apply" legal disclosure.

Hide tools from the agent when their prerequisite tools are not called or if the tools is not eligible for the current user. Handles the following list of tools (format: Tool: [Prerequisite]):
- send_appointment_link_sms: [called play_sms_legal_disclosure]

afterModelCallbacks.description: Handle transfer to Graceful Signoff Agent after the agent response (e.g. "Ok, the text is on the way").
